intent: Integration tests for Bedrock's Query/Write command path: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, the no-WHERE safety guard, parallel writes, HTTP-style and shorthand syntax, and blocking of non-deterministic SQL functions on write.

objects.name: WriteTest
objects.role: tpunit fixture (BedrockTester-backed) with 15 tests over write-command behavior

misfits.why: asserts on a known SQL-parsing limitation (an UPDATE without a WHERE-safety marker is not aborted in this specific case) that the test comment says is tracked in an external Expensify issue, rather than asserting intended behavior
